IRON YARD — single-use owner-authorized PUBLIC Roblox shooter update.
Date: 2026-11-12. Continue production game, do not publish alpha/private.
This change provides distinct original cartridge movement for AR, pistol,
shotgun and sniper including the server-timed pump/bolt delay. A shotgun
red polymer hull is no longer rendered as reflective brass. Pooled parts
reset reflectance when reused, while casing gravity and tumble remain
client-only cosmetics with no new instances beyond the existing pool.
Require complete exact-SHA green Luau/Rojo CI and authorized public
owner/place verification before publication. No weapons gameplay changes.
